title: Generative Anchored Fields: Endpoint Learning for Generative Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2511.22693v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present Generative Anchored Fields (GAF), a generative model that learns independent endpoint predictors, \(J\) (noise) and \(K\) (data), from any point on a linear bridge. Instead of learning the local path along a trajectory, as in diffusion or flow-based models, GAF is trained to identify the endpoint coordinates of a bridge state directly via an endpoint regression objective. Central to our approach is the decoupling of time-dependent feature learning from endpoint prediction. Unlike the transport-based models that learn a monolithic time-conditioned predictor that maps noise to data via a unified field, GAF uses a shared trunk, \(\Phi\), which produces a time-conditioned feature bank and a pair of linear predictors, \(J\) and \(K\). tldr: 提出生成锚定场（GAF），通过将时间条件化特征学习与端点预测解耦，直接学习噪声和数据端点预测器，并借助“传输代数”实现可组合的采样。
